import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_clean = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in sleep_disorder_clean.unique():
    mask = sleep_disorder_clean == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df.loc[mask, 'Sleep Duration'], 
               df.loc[mask, 'Quality of Sleep'],
               alpha=0.6, s=80, label=disorder)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='best')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Disorders
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
disorder_counts = sleep_disorder_clean.value_counts()
colors_disorder = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(disorder_counts))
ax2.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        startangle=90, colors=colors_disorder)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
colors_occ = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.2, 0.9, len(occupation_sleep)))
bars = ax3.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors_occ)
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, v in enumerate(occupation_sleep.values):
    ax3.text(v + 0.05, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Stress Level vs Physical Activity
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
           alpha=0.5, c=df['Age'], cmap='coolwarm', s=50)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)
cbar = plt.colorbar(ax4.collections[0], ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=10)

# 5. BMI Category distribution by Gender
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
bmi_gender = pd.crosstab(df['BMI Category'], df['Gender'])
bmi_gender.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=['#FF69B4', '#4169E1'], width=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_title('BMI Category by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(title='Gender', loc='best')
ax5.set_xticklabels(ax5.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
scatter = ax6.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], 
                     c=df['Sleep Duration'], cmap='YlOrRd', 
                     alpha=0.6, s=50, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)
cbar2 = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax6)
cbar2.set_label('Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=9)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', 
            fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
